items.title: Louis Armstrong Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: There's Mr. Boynstein at the Lureship Stadium.

ctx.x: I don't care what time I come home. Every night or morning, whatever it is. I could have maybe one too many. I got plenty of time before I go to work. But this is what we prepare for you to go to work. And after you wake up, that's what counts. And then with a little paraphernalia like Witch Hazel and Lips Ave, you know, from Germany. And the little thing that you believe in. And in your strategy of blowing a horn, just at least a little warm up and you're ready to go to work. And that was kind of as tiny as it…
